title: Facility
description: A table schema describing a dealer facility

type.description: Kind of facility: showroom (sales site where cars are displayed, indoor or open-air), service (servicing, mechanical and body repair), warehouse (storage of stock not on display), delivery (handover or pick-up point), office (administrative site with no cars on site)

country.description: Country where the facility is located

region.description: State or region within the country

city.description: Closest city where the facility is located

postcode.description: Postal code of the facility location

phone.description: Contact phone number for the facility

email.description: Contact email address for the facility

lon.description: Longitude coordinate of the facility location

lat.description: Latitude coordinate of the facility location
